exercises.prompt: Match each derived noun to its morphological category:
exercises.explanation: Place/time nouns begin with مَـ (مَفْعِلٌ/مَفْعَلٌ), instruments with مِـ (مِفْعَالٌ), and diminutives use فُعَيْلٌ.

feedback.rule: Derived nominal patterns: مَفْعِلٌ, مِفْعَالٌ, فُعَيْلٌ.

exercises.prompt: True or False: Nouns of instrument typically begin with the prefix مَـ (fatḥah), while nouns of place begin with مِـ (kasrah).
exercises.explanation: False—it is the reverse: nouns of place/time begin with مَـ (مَسْجِدٌ, مَكْتَبٌ) and nouns of instrument begin with مِـ (مِفْتَاحٌ, مِيزَانٌ).
